Omkareshwar Temple Changes Darshan System for Devotees

The Omkareshwar temple has implemented a new system for devotees to view the Jyotirlinga. Devotees will now be able to have darshan from a distance of 10 feet, a change from the previous arrangement. This new system aims to prevent crowding and pushing, providing relief to pilgrims. The temple administration has introduced this arrangement after 100 years.
